template.title: The Tiny Piano Bird
template.summary: A child helps a small bird stuck in a bush, learns kindness, and shares a snack under a tree.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the garden.
One sunny day, they heard a soft chirp from a [[slot_animal]] perched on a branch.
The [[slot_animal]] had a bright [[slot_color]] feather that fell to the ground.
[[slot_child]] looked at the feather and felt a tug in their heart.
They could have taken the feather and kept it, but they chose to help the [[slot_animal]].
Using a [[slot_tool]], [[slot_child]] gently freed the bird from the tangled bush.
The bird sang a song that sounded like a tiny piano, and the garden filled with music.
[[slot_child]] shared their [[slot_snack_food]] with the bird, and they both sat under the [[slot_tree]] tree.
The bird flapped its wings and flew away, leaving a trail of glittering dust.
[[slot_child]] felt warm and happy, knowing they made a new friend.
